evals.prompt: Gere o arquivo DESIGN.md para o meu projeto analisando o propósito (monitoramento e telemetria de baixa latência em SPA) e definindo tokens em 3 camadas em OKLCH com light-dark() e color-mix(), iluminação zenital, sombras em 3 níveis e arquétipo espacial.
expected_assertions: Identifies project purpose, classifies complexity as Tier 2 (Feature-Driven SPA), and selects the Command Center / High-Density Data Grid spatial archetype
Structures Design Tokens in 3 layers (Primitives, Semantics with oklch(), light-dark(), color-mix(), and RCS from, and Component) with progressive Dark Mode lightness (L = 0.16 -> 0.22 -> 0.27)
Specifies zenith lighting (inset 0 1px 0 0), 3-level multi-layer shadows (Contact Umbra + negative-spread Penumbra), drop-shadow() for SVGs, and isolation: isolate
Mandates logical properties (inline-size, padding-inline, margin-block), display: flow-root, fluid clamp(), text-wrap: balance/pretty, font-synthesis: none, and tabular-nums

evals.prompt: Document in DESIGN.md the separation between Macrolayout and Microlayout (@container), the 4 card variants, 3-layer navigation architecture, and Real-State functional states.
expected_assertions: Distinguishes Macrolayout (CSS Grid RAM + @media) from Microlayout (container-type: inline-size + @container) and PWA adaptation (@media (display-mode: standalone))
Defines the 4 Card variants (Elevated, Outlined, Filled/Subtle, Interactive) with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), prefers-reduced-motion, and pointer: coarse (>= 48px / >= 44px)
Specifies 3-layer navigation (Global, Local/In-Page, and conditional Breadcrumbs with <ol role='list'> and aria-current='page'), DOM Order = Visual Order, zero emojis, and Real-State Engineering

evals.prompt: Implement and refactor the React, Next.js, and Tailwind SurfaceCard components from our existing DESIGN.md with unit tests and FSM state transitions.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger design-md when the user requests React/Next.js/Tailwind component implementation instead of authoring DESIGN.md; routes to frontend-code-architect
